messages:
Ruth Calder: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — capturing the win/loss patterns and the small set of asks leadership should weigh in on.

Marco Diaz: From sales reviews: wins = predictable burst handling & transparent per-token cost reporting. Losses = inability to provide BYO-KMS in-customer-VPC and slow on-prem demo turnaround.

Helena Brooks: CS input: procurement keeps asking for exportable audit streams + per-team billing tags. That's consistently stalling deals.

Vikram Shah: Engineering note on losses: one deal failed the security review because they couldn't run a quick air-gapped check; they'd accepted a tiny reference bundle from competitors.

Marco Diaz: Customers also called out streaming tail latency during prolonged sessions as a concern — one RFP flagged p99 spikes under sustained concurrent streams.

Sylvia Tran: Quick wins requested by field: 1) short one-pager "what we support today vs roadmap" for Sales/CS, 2) recommended canary config samples, 3) streaming best-practices snippet for prefix caching in SDK.

Ruth Calder: Leadership asks: please confirm priority of BYO-KMS + audit export vs on-prem reference artifact vs eval-gate in Console. Which should be Q1 hard priorities?

Vikram Shah: My recommendation: 1) BYO-KMS in VPC + audit export (Q1), 2) Console eval-block prototype (Q1 prototype), 3) minimal air-gapped reference artifact (fast-follow early Q2).

Helena Brooks: Ops/Infra blockers? We need rough ETAs to put in the one-pager.

deploy-bot: Infra blockers (summary): INF-903 (KMS-proxy-auth), INF-911 (audit-export-durability), INF-924 (VPC onboarding automation). Status: triaged; rough lead time 4-7w if prioritized.

Marco Diaz: Sales asks PM/docs for that one-pager by next Wed. Also want 1-2 anonymized customer lines we can slip into proposals.

Sylvia Tran: I'll collect quotes from CS and paste them here by EOD. Example: "We chose the vendor that could hand us audit exports during procurement." (can anonymize)

Ruth Calder: Action items I captured: (A) PM/docs produce one-pager by Wed, (B) Infra/Eng confirm blockers + ETA by Thu EOD, (C) DevEx publish canary sample + prefix-caching snippet this sprint, (D) Ops create a tiny on-prem reference spec for early Q2, (E) Eng/Platform provide 1-paragraph blurb for next all-hands.

Vikram Shah: Also flagging headcount request: if Execs want Q1 KMS/audit, we should reallocate 1-2 infra engineers to accelerate INF-903/911.

Ruth Calder: I'll surface the headcount ask to Execs and report back by Friday. If anyone has additional customer quotes or short repro logs for the streaming p99 spikes, drop them here.

Marco Diaz: :thumbsup: will add a sanitized quote.

Helena Brooks: Ops will upload a minimal repro trace for the streaming issue to the shared drive and ping this thread when done.

Ruth Calder: Great — thanks team. I'll synthesize this into a short action tracker and post to #product after infra replies.

Sylvia Tran: End of thread for now — will follow up in #sales-docs with the one-pager draft.
